name: CPython
description: The reference implementation of the Python language.
summary: AI tools are fine for code, issues and comments as long as the author reviews the output and takes responsibility. Disclosing AI use is appreciated but not required.

evidence.quote: The person submitting an issue or PR is responsible for its content, regardless of whether AI tools were used in its creation.
Disclosure of the use of AI tools in the PR description is appreciated, while not required.
Authors must review the work done by AI tooling in detail to ensure it actually makes sense before proposing it as a PR or filing it as an issue.
Always review the output before opening a pull request or issue, including proposed PR or issue titles and descriptions.
